definition: Ling Shao (邵岭) is a British-Chinese scientist and entrepreneur in the field of artificial intelligence, best known for founding the Inception Institute of Artificial Intelligence (IIAI) and the Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI), in Abu Dhabi, the United Arab Emirates.

story: Imagine an art restorer who can spot a single cracked tile in a vast mosaic. What your eyes do without thinking, the machine does one careful layer at a time. The machine learns to see the way we do — starting with shapes and edges, then building up to whole objects and faces. The model looks the way you look at a crowd and finds the one face you know. And that is Ling Shao — giving a machine the gift of sight.
